description: This file implements the AddressTrackerLinux class, which manages network interface addresses and link states on Linux systems using netlink sockets. It handles address updates, interface status changes, and connection type determination, primarily for network monitoring within the Chromium project.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages network address and link state tracking on Linux using netlink sockets, providing updates on network interfaces, addresses, and connection type.

classes.name: AddressTrackerAutoLock
classes.description: Helper class for managing lock acquisition and release within AddressTrackerLinux to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the interface name given its index.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for AddressTrackerLinux.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes the tracker with a provided file descriptor for testing.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the netlink socket and starts address and link monitoring.

methods.name: AbortAndForceOnline
methods.description: Stops tracking and sets network state to unknown.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns the current map of addresses.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns the set of online link indices.

methods.name: GetAddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Returns pointer to self.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns initial address and link data, and prepares for diff tracking.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked on network diffs.

methods.name: IsInterfaceIgnored
methods.description: Checks if an interface is ignored based on its index.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: DumpInitialAddressesAndWatch
methods.description: Requests initial address and link state dumps and starts watching for updates.

methods.name: ReadMessages
methods.description: Reads and processes netlink messages from the socket.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles individual netlink messages, updating address and link states.

methods.name: OnFileCanReadWithoutBlocking
methods.description: Callback invoked when netlink socket is readable to process messages.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterface
methods.description: Determines if an interface name indicates a tunnel interface.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterfaceName
methods.description: Checks if a given interface name is a tunnel interface.

methods.name: UpdateCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Updates the network connection type based on current interface states.

methods.name: RunDiffCallback
methods.description: Invokes the diff callback with accumulated address and link changes.

methods.name: GetThreadsWaitingForConnectionTypeInitForTesting
methods.description: Returns the number of threads waiting for connection type initialization.
